provenance: Self-authored programs executed in fresh original virtual G1 build15751 profiles. Touch press/hold/move/release were sent only after the program painted its readiness marker. No vendor bytes or physical-hardware claim. VM packet tests exercise the Host boundary separately from actual GUI pointer delivery.

controls.name: idle_shape
controls.source: EXPORT MOUSEIDLE() BEGIN LOCAL m:=MOUSE; RETURN {TYPE(m),DIM(m),SIZE(m),m,MOUSE(0),MOUSE(1),MOUSE(2),MOUSE(3),MOUSE(4),MOUSE(5)}; END;

controls.name: idle_index_strings
controls.source: EXPORT MOUSEINDEX() BEGIN LOCAL m:=MOUSE,r; IFERR r:=m[1,1]; THEN r:="caught"; END; RETURN STRING({m,r}); END;

controls.name: idle_range
controls.source: EXPORT MOUSERANGE() BEGIN LOCAL out:={},k,r; FOR k FROM -2 TO 12 DO IFERR r:=MOUSE(k); THEN r:="caught"; END; out:=CONCAT(out,{{k,TYPE(r),STRING(r)}}); END; RETURN STRING(out); END;

controls.name: admission
controls.source: EXPORT MOUSEADMIT() BEGIN LOCAL vals:={-0.5,0.5,1.9,9.9,10.1,#2h,"2",{2},(1,2)},k,r,out:={}; FOR k FROM 1 TO SIZE(vals) DO IFERR r:=MOUSE(vals(k)); THEN r:="caught"; END; out:=CONCAT(out,{{k,TYPE(r),STRING(r)}}); END; RETURN STRING(out); END;

controls.name: hold_drag_release
controls.source: EXPORT MOUSETOUCH() BEGIN LOCAL out:={},m,last:="",text,t:=TICKS; RECT_P(#123456h); WHILE TICKS-t<6000 DO m:=MOUSE; text:=STRING(m); IF text≠last THEN out:=CONCAT(out,{{m,MOUSE(0),MOUSE(1),MOUSE(2),MOUSE(3),MOUSE(4),MOUSE(5),MOUSE(6)}}); last:=text; END; END; RETURN out; END;

controls.name: hold_drag_release
controls.source: EXPORT MOUSETOUCH() BEGIN LOCAL out:={},m,last:="",text,t:=TICKS,row,k; RECT_P(#123456h); WHILE TICKS-t<7000 DO m:=MOUSE; text:=STRING(m); IF text≠last THEN row:={m}; IF SIZE(m(1))>0 THEN FOR k FROM 1 TO 5 DO row:=CONCAT(row,{{TYPE(m(1,k)),GETBITS(m(1,k)),GETBASE(m(1,k))}}); END; END; out:=CONCAT(out,{row}); last:=text; END; END; RETURN STRING(out); END;

limitations: The controlled1.2second hold did not produce LongClick. Completed/Stretch/Rotate/LongClick input-generation behavior needs separate validation; enum codes follow the HP guide609.
